findings.message: No test bounds the number of pending deferred sightings. intel.test.ts only asserts single-entry pending arrays (lines 233, 346), and property.test.ts:334 only records that some pending entry existed (EXERCISED 'sighting:deferred') without checking a bound or that it was delivered. The implementation (step.ts:344) keeps one pending entry per type, not per player, so a test of the per-player bound would not pass as written. Whether that deviation is acceptable is for the general reviewer; as it stands, the bound is untested.
findings.requirement: it is delivered at the next snapshot boundary (at most one pending per player)

findings.message: No test enforces that carrier sightings come only from the three listed triggers. The property Checker (property.test.ts:405-424) accepts a carrier-sighting with any reason, and the scripted test intel.test.ts:175 asserts a sighting with reason 'start', which is a fourth trigger. The cap and age rules are tested, but this restriction has no test, and the suite asserts the opposite case.
findings.requirement: It is sent only on three triggers: a fresh rumor after a loss when every other copy is carried, a targeted rumor under the same condition, or a journal replacement when every remaining copy is carried.
